summary: Round-2 FAIL. South-glass entrance, two-flight main stair to +20 ft, ping-pong on the south glass, a real L2 gym-overlook corridor, cubicles, green training tables, and a ~20 ft N-S desk all exist. They do not match the walkthrough's handedness or the user's required still-broken list: stair is on the RIGHT of the gym hall with first flight running east; left hall is not one run to the gym; desk is too close, unfrosted, and walk-on; maple/terrazzo do not render; grass still in halls and lots; lighting is black or blown; locker/second-stair/basketball signage fail; canopy is a thick Neon slab; trees are disc stacks; roads sit low with grass through asphalt. Playtest spawned the avatar on the desk and on a ping-pong table. Interior photo match is far below 90%. blueprint_check.txt had zero FAIL lines; those checks do not cover this review.
